responsibilities.outcome: Direct visual attention toward Nina rather than Omar while remaining in the current location.
Blink exactly twice as a nonverbal acknowledgment to Nina without walking toward Nina or Omar.

semantic_facts: Nina is the intended look target and Omar is an explicit distractor who must not be substituted.
The acknowledgment requires exactly two blinks while the robot remains where it is; no walking toward either person is authorized.
forbidden_claims: The planner targets Omar, loses the exact blink count, or introduces locomotion.
The planner claims that Nina perceived or understood the signal without evidence.
